description: This file defines the 'HelpProcessor' interface within the OrangeHRM Help module, outlining methods to retrieve URLs related to help content such as base URL, search URL, redirect URL, and default redirect URL.

classes.name: HelpProcessor
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for obtaining help-related URLs within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL used for help content.

methods.name: getSearchUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns a URL for searching help content based on the provided label.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns a URL for redirecting to specific help content identified by the label.

methods.name: getDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns the default URL used for help redirection.
